newsitem.title: USA: Vastar sees 1997 E&P expenses at $575MLN.
newsitem.headline: Vastar sees 1997 E&P expenses at $575MLN.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc foresees having 1997 exploration and production expenditures of $575 million, about unchanged from 1996 levels, a Vastar executive said.

"It will be about the same, at about $575 million," said Pamela Pierce, vice president of business development at the Houston-based company, who was attending the annual Herold's Pacesetters Energy Conference here on Thursday.

She said the exploration component would be $250 million, of which $35 million would be pegged toward seismic analysis of prospective oil and gas drilling sites -- all in line with this year's spending.
She said $40 million to $50 million would be spent on exploration prospects in deep Gulf of Mexico waters, also steady with 1996.
She said 74 percent of the company's reserves were natural gas and the remaining 26 percent crude oil, based on energy content of the reserves rather than financial vallue of the assets.
Thirty-eight percent of the company's reserves are in the Gulf of Mexico, with the remainder in the inland United States.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1620
